Step: 1/3
Model: provider/exact-model-id

For a human verification PR, replace Step and Model with:

## What changed

Describe the work, pages, and any notation that needs particular attention.

## Checks

- [ ] The LilyPond compiles without errors.
- [ ] The rendered PDF was compared page by page with the printed source.
- [ ] The music was entered visually from the printed edition; Audiveris and all other OMR/OCR, score-recognition, MusicXML, MIDI, and existing digital transcriptions were not used.
- [ ] For Steps 1–2, the agent did not inspect the other attempt.
- [ ] If this is human verification, the original PDF and rendered PDF were compared throughout the piece.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check.py --write` was run.
